Workshops & Concerts

Come hear it live.

Special workshops with visiting artists, member concerts, and one-off gatherings — open to the public and hosted at Jazz Central Studios in Minneapolis. Here's what's coming up, and what's already happened.

Next up
Saturday, June 13, 2026

Otherlands Trio Workshop

A special workshop with Stephan Crump (acoustic bass), Darius Jones (alto saxophone), and Eric McPherson (drums) — on spontaneous composition, ensemble connection, and the trio's approach to making music. Open to the public.

Past workshops

The artists we've hosted
Quartet Clinic · April 2026

Alex Hitchcock Quartet

Saxophonist Alex Hitchcock with Lex Korten, JK Kim & Ben Tiberio — on creative process and developing your own voice, during the Letters From Afar tour.

Artist Residency · December 2025

Kavyesh Kaviraj

Pianist and composer on band dynamics, storytelling, and finding “order out of chaos” in group playing.

Improvisation Workshop · October 2025

Mary Petrich

Improvisation strategies for women and non-binary musicians — breaking habits and finding your own voice.

Ensemble Clinic

Javier Santiago

Pianist Javier Santiago with Corey Fonville (Butcher Brown) and bassist Zach Brown on real-time group communication and creative decision-making.

Drum Clinic

Pete James Johnson

Drummer and educator on the role of the drummer in small-group jazz — time feel, listening, and interaction.

Guitar Clinic

Chris Olson

Veteran guitarist on jazz accompaniment, chord voicings, and comping with intention.

Vocal Workshop

Rachel Holder

Vocalist on improvisation, phrasing, and storytelling through song — for singers at any level.
